title: Faster clear, staff tools and settings backups
body: !cls now clears the whole chat in one go, and the report comes to you by PM so the chat stays empty. New !voxstaff shows the official VOXbots staff in any room, so you can check anyone who says they work for us. Owners can now back up their bot’s settings to a file, restore them, or copy them from another bot (Settings, Backup and restore).

title: Talk to staff from Discord
body:
Our staff can now follow this chat from our Discord server and answer you right here, even when they're away from xat.

Messages from staff show up as [Discord] Name, so you always know who you're talking to.

title: Pick your pings on Discord
body: Our Discord now has a roles channel. Click Announcements, Bot status or Giveaways to get pinged only about the things you care about. Click again to stop.

title: !clear tells you what happened
body: After !clear (or !cls), the bot now says how many messages were deleted, and whose messages stayed because their rank is too high for the bot to remove.

title: Mail any VOXbots chat
body:
Use !mail name message to leave mail for anyone in any chat with a VOXbots bot. They'll be told about it next time they join.

!mail check, !mail read, !mail delete and !mail block keep your inbox tidy.

title: Pay with xats or days
body:
Transfer xats or days to the bot account with only your Bot ID as the message, and your bot time is added straight away.

Always transfer to the bot itself, never to a person.
